column1: # HIMMEL-4758 (HIMMEL-4748 spec section 1): project-mode resolver answers, one
# case per line, read by BOTH resolvers so they cannot drift apart:
# origin of forge-origins.tsv (github/bitbucket as listed, none -> local-git).
#   fn        tracker | forge | forge-guard | pattern | required | phases | env
#   origin    a URL (git repo with that origin), `-` (git repo, no remote),
#             or NOGIT (a plain directory outside any work tree)
#   env       `-` or space-separated KEY=VALUE pairs (nothing else is set)
#   gitconfig `-` or space-separated key=value pairs, set with `git config`;
#             `%20` in a value stands for a space (the column is space-split)
#   expected  stdout, `<empty>` for an empty line, or EXIT2 (refused, rc 2).
#             In env rows, `\t` stands for a TAB.
# --- RED: no TRACKER, no JIRA_PROJECT_KEY -> local
# --- CI row: key set, no Jira creds -> jira (creds are never consulted)
# --- tracker precedence: env > git config > detection
# --- a padded git config value is not trimmed (the shell's $(...) strips only the trailing newline): both twins refuse
# --- ID pattern: override > jira key > local prefix alternated with #N > none
# --- ID required: explicit env value verbatim > none -> 0 > 1
# --- forge precedence: env > git config > detection
# --- I8: local-git is never selected on a github.com / bitbucket.org origin
# --- I8: --for-guard reads detection only; env and git config never steer it
